article.headline: Dionjahe Thomas' double-double propels Southern to 69-53 victory over Bethune-Cookman
article.description: — Dionjahe Thomas finished with 15 points and 13 rebounds to power Southern to a 69-53 victory over Bethune-Cookman on Monday night.
article.linkText: Dionjahe Thomas' double-double propels Southern to 69-53 victory over Bethune-Cookman
article.story: BATON ROUGE, La. -- — Dionjahe Thomas finished with 15 points and 13 rebounds to power Southern to a 69-53 victory over Bethune-Cookman on Monday night. Jordan Johnson had 10 points and Michael Jacobs scored eight for the Jaguars (9-8, 4-0 Southwestern Athletic Conference). The Wildcats (5-11, 2-1) were led by Daniel Rouzan, who posted 15 points. Bethune-Cookman also got eight points from Tre Thomas. Brayon Freeman also had seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
